proposals.title: Schur's inequality
proposals.content: [dry-run] \label{lem:schur} For all real numbers $a, b, c \ge 0$, \[ a(a-b)(a-c) + b(b-a)(b-c) + c(c-a)(c-b) \ge 0 . \]
proposals.reuse_evidence: Built into your toolkit in round A.
proposals.lean_type: \label{lem:schur} For all real numbers $a, b, c \ge 0$, \[ a(a-b)(a-c) + b(b-a)(b-c) + c(c-a)(c-b) \ge 0 . \]

proposals.title: $x^2+y^2 \ge 2xy$
